s-1.ptxt: Inspect Rear Stabilizer Link Assembly LH

atten3.ptxt: The nut, rear stabilizer link assembly LH and rear stabilizer cushions cannot be reused, so install new ones.

s3.ptxt: Secure the rear stabilizer link assembly LH in a vise using aluminum plates.
Install the nut to the stud of the rear stabilizer link assembly LH.
Swing the stud back and forth 5 times, then turn the nut continuously at a rate of 3-5 seconds per turn and measure the turning torque on the 5 turn.

specitem.ptxt: No abnormal catching or play during rotation

s3.ptxt: Check that the dust cover is not cracked and that there is no grease leakage.
